scripts.sync:csmatrix: rm -rf docs/csmatrix docs-gm/csmatrix && cp -R public/csmatrix docs/csmatrix && cp -R public/csmatrix docs-gm/csmatrix
scripts.sync:chud: cp -f public/chud/meter-bridge.js docs/chud/meter-bridge.js && cp -f public/chud/meter-bridge.js docs-gm/chud/meter-bridge.js && cp -f public/chud/assets/chud-app.css docs/chud/assets/chud-app.css && cp -f public/chud/assets/chud-app.css docs-gm/chud/assets/chud-app.css
scripts.sync:subapps: npm run sync:csmatrix && npm run sync:chud
scripts.build:chud: vite build --config vite.chud.config.ts && mv public/chud/chud.html public/chud/index.html
scripts.build: npm run build:chud && tsc -b && vite build
